entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sir George Dashwood Taubman Goldie was a Manx administrator who played a major role in the founding of Colonial Nigeria. In many ways, his role was similar to that of Cecil Rhodes elsewhere in Africa but he did not seek publicity.
